# Quiz Preview Dependencies

- Marked 18.2.1: https://github.com/markedjs/marked (MIT, see marked-LICENSE.txt).
- DOMPurify 3.5.0: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify (Apache-2.0, see DOMPurify-LICENSE.txt).

These pinned browser distributions are served locally and also support the offline
quiz builder. Markdown raw HTML is displayed as text; rendered Markdown is
sanitized before insertion into the preview DOM.
